renderReviewCaveat: Milestone 15 found generateMarkup repeats descendants as top-level siblings, bypassing ancestor clipping in earlier review renders. Renderer now retains only the selected native board hierarchy and frames its native bounds. Earlier milestone SVGs remain original evidence; prior clipped/overlapping layouts require renewed render inspection with the corrected renderer.
profileStateAudit: profile-state-audit.md: upload/decode failures have no implemented error notice; existing editor state remains. Native validation/file-picker/session confirmation references still missing.
nativePickerInvestigation: investigations/native-picker/README.md: isolated Electron native picker not visible in capture; reference still missing.
